target_customer: Startups and technology companies, up to large enterprises, that need patent and trademark filing and portfolio management
problem: Patent counsel is slow and billed hourly with unpredictable cost; the firm uses software and search to give flat fee filings with big firm quality.
business_model: Tech enabled law firm charging flat fees per filing
product_category: Legal services, patent and trademark counsel

founders.name: Bryant Lee
education: Studied computer science, then attended law school (TechCrunch, Feb 2018)
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder by TechCrunch Feb 2018; VentureBeat July 2019 calls him CEO and a patent lawyer.

founders.name: Andrew Tjang
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as Founder/CEO, VentureBeat 2019 calls him CTO and an assistant professor of computer science at Rutgers.

competitors.name: Google Patents
competitors.what: Free patent search tool used by firms to find prior art, and Google was named as working on better patent experiences

technical_complexity.rationale: Semantic patent search and a topic graph over the patent database were reported by TechCrunch in 2018, which is standard machine learning work with some hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Law firm services are copyable by other firms adding software; the engine improves with use but was not shown to be proprietary.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copy or purchase was found in sources; the firm still operates with a 12 person team.

market_need_then: Hourly patent counsel is costly for startups; TechCrunch 2018 said the firm aimed to double the roughly 50 clients a patent lawyer can handle through automation.

identity.voice_and_tone: Professional legal voice with fixed fee and no hidden fees messaging

branding.community_and_virality: Company site lists a community manager and events, and says it was mentioned in TechCrunch, Y Combinator and Law.com

brand_strength.rationale: Press mentions exist but the name is shared in search with the unrelated AI company Cognition, which dominates results.

outcome_analysis: Cognition IP launched in YC Winter 2018 as a patent law firm with software, raised a 2.8M seed from Khosla, Mayfield and Basis Set in July 2019, and is still operating with about 12 people. Law firms scale slowly and no later round or exit was found, so it looks like a steady small firm rather than a venture scale outcome.
notes: CB Insights reports 2.92M across four rounds, unconfirmed by other outlets. Search for outcomes returns the unrelated AI company Cognition (Devin, Windsurf), which is a naming confusion, not this company. YC page lists Tjang as CEO while VentureBeat 2019 lists Lee as CEO and Tjang as CTO.
